x_definition: Cumulative summary.wall_seconds at each round end / 60; includes qualification waits; not whole-run calendar time
event_curve_definition: Counts reported at round end; starts from zero for this window; not exact within-round event times or independent discoveries

utility_definition.program_promotions: Strict training-program incumbent events, checked against summary counts
utility_definition.cumulative_program_promotions: Running sum within this window only; starts from zero
utility_definition.completed_round_wall_seconds: summary.wall_seconds; rates divide total completed rounds or strict program promotions by their summed wall time
utility_definition.reported_best_round: adapter_admission.best_round; a logged identity, not the first strict increase in utility

source_binding: Field interpretation only; installed run source/checkpoint qualification remains required
scope: Retained development observations only; no independent first-proposal, transfer or deployment claim
